choices.goals: Six singleton vetoes on types 1 through 6; three held goals uniformly drawn; types 0 and 7 always allowed.
choices.habit_normalization: Normalize each row; reader uniform over three habits and twenty goal subsets.
choices.misread: Assign all attention to vetoes; assume no random or planning source.
choices.planning: Independent probability .5 at every fourth unit; combined by OR with random and violation attention.
choices.primary: Total 32-unit evidence across eight makers divided by total violation events within each world; also per any attention event.
choices.revision: Replaced proposal observed only when vetoed; otherwise explicit no replacement.
